objective: Identify and rank possible capabilities from repeated measured demand without creating, installing, or authorizing features.
verification_requirements: Inspect bounded evidence from recent tasks, failures, expensive workflows, manual procedures, missing tools, user interventions, benchmark weaknesses, and token waste reports.
Return problem, frequency, current cost, proposed capability, measurable expected benefit, complexity, security risk, benchmark, and derived BUILD, DEFER, or REJECT.
BUILD requires verified repeated demand across at least three tasks and two evidence families, measured cost, bounded complexity, and no high security risk.
Do not create, install, activate, authorize, or write memory for any proposed capability from this unbound template.
